subject: Intro: Redwood x MortgageMate — AWS joint account sync request
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@mortgagemate.com>, Tom Briggs <tbriggs@amazon.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-04-12T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Intro: Redwood x MortgageMate — AWS joint account sync request

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks for taking the time to connect last week. MortgageMate's proof-of-concept looked great, and we discussed the next step being a short AWS + Redwood joint planning call to align procurement timelines, technical requirements, and success metrics before the upcoming exec review.

Proposed agenda (30 minutes):
- Intros and roles (5m)
- High-level solution fit and hosting preference (Redwood Hosted vs Dedicated) (7m)
- Procurement / procurement timeline and security gates (7m)
- Mutual action plan and next steps (8m)

Can we target the week of Apr 17 for a 30-minute sync? Elena — what does your procurement timeline look like? If helpful I can drop a shared MA-plan template and our lightweight product deck.

Attachments: redwood-product-deck-v2.pdf (product overview)

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@mortgagemate.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>, Tom Briggs <tbriggs@amazon.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-04-12T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood x MortgageMate — AWS joint account sync request

Hi Ben / Tom —

Thanks — happy to align. Our procurement committee is meeting the week of Apr 24, and we need security/architecture notes before then. High level: we prefer AWS-managed hosting; open to Dedicated if SLA and data isolation are clear. I've attached a short procurement timeline and the list of people who will join the committee.

Attachments: MortgageMate_procurement_timeline.pdf

Availability: Apr 18 (10–11am PDT) or Apr 19 (2–3pm PDT) work for the core team. If AWS needs to bring an SE, please loop them in.

—Elena
Elena Ruiz
VP, Platform & Ops
MortgageMate

From: Tom Briggs <tbriggs@amazon.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena@mortgagemate.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-04-13T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood x MortgageMate — AWS joint account sync request

Hi all —

Thanks for the context. I can join the call and will bring Shane Li (Solutions Architect) to cover networking/VPC and marketplace procurement flow. Shane — @Shane Li <shane@amazon.com> — can you review the procurement timeline and let us know any AWS-side gating items we should flag ahead of the meeting?

Tom Briggs
Partner Development Manager, AWS

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena@mortgagemate.com>, Tom Briggs <tbriggs@amazon.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-04-13T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood x MortgageMate — AWS joint account sync request

Great — thanks for looping everyone. I've drafted a short mutual action plan and attached an editable workbook so we can track owners and dates. Key suggested milestones (first pass):

- Week of Apr 17: Joint scoping call (30m) — agree roles and high-level hosting option
- Apr 18–Apr 21: Security questionnaire / initial architecture notes (Redwood to provide)
- Apr 24: Procurement committee review (MortgageMate) — target to answer open gating items
- Apr 25–May 2: Pilot contract / PO drafting and legal review
- May 8: Pilot kickoff (if procurement clears)

Owners (first pass):
- Redwood: Ben (commercial), Karthik (MA plan + ops), Lauren (security/compliance intake)
- MortgageMate: Elena (procurement/ops), Daniel Park (CTO, technical lead on pilot)
- AWS: Tom (partner lead), Shane (solutions architecture)

I've attached the mutual action plan template: redwood-ma-plan.xlsx. Also attaching a short product deck for the committees: redwood-product-deck-v2.pdf.

Please confirm the meeting slot that works best and I'll send a calendar invite + a short pre-read packet (2 pages).

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@mortgagemate.com>, Tom Briggs <tbriggs@amazon.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-04-14T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood x MortgageMate — AWS joint account sync request

Elena / Tom —

Thanks everyone — based on availability we'll lock Apr 18, 10:00–10:30am PDT for the joint sync. Calendar invite and dial-in will follow.

Pre-read items I will share in the invite:
- 2-page architecture note (Redwood)
- Redacted SOC/controls checklist summary (Redwood)
- Mutual action plan workbook (editable)

If there are any specific gating docs AWS needs (e.g., marketplace listing flow, KMS/HSM notes), Shane please flag and we'll include.

Looking forward to it.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
